blocks.text:
Duration: 8–9 Hours
Pick-Up: 9:00 – 9:30 AM
Languages: English and Spanish

Step into the fascinating world of the Ancient Maya during today’s excursion to some of the most impressive archaeological sites in the Yucatán region.

Your exploration begins at Uxmal, a UNESCO World Heritage Site celebrated for its elegant architecture and remarkable decorative details. Walk through this magnificent ancient city and admire iconic structures such as the Pyramid of the Magician, the grand Governor’s Palace, and the beautifully carved Nunnery Quadrangle, each reflecting the sophistication of Maya artistry, astronomy, and ceremonial life.

Continue to the nearby archaeological site of Kabah, known for its striking stone façades covered with intricate sculptures and masks dedicated to the rain god Chaac.

The day concludes with a refreshing stop at a cenote, a natural freshwater pool hidden within the jungle and considered sacred by the Maya. Here you can relax and enjoy a swim in its crystal-clear waters.

Included:
• Shared transportation
• Certified bilingual guide
• Entrance to Uxmal, Kabah, and the cenote
• Overnight stay in Mérida

Not Included:
• Meals
• Tips
• Personal expenses

blocks.text:
(PT) Private Transfer Mérida to Chichén Itzá and Shared Day Tour
Duration: Full Day
Pick-Up: 9:00 – 9:30 AM
Languages: English and Spanish

Today’s journey connects the ancient world of the Maya with the turquoise waters of the Caribbean coast.

Your day begins with a private transfer from Mérida to Chichén Itzá, one of the most famous archaeological sites in the world and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Upon arrival, join a shared guided tour to explore the site’s most remarkable landmarks, including the iconic Temple of Kukulkán, the mysterious Sacred Cenote, and the impressive Great Ball Court, one of the largest ever built in Mesoamerica.

After exploring the ruins, cool off with a refreshing swim in a nearby cenote, followed by a traditional Yucatecan lunch featuring regional flavors.

The journey continues with a stop in the charming colonial town of Valladolid, where you can stroll through colorful streets, admire historic architecture, and experience the relaxed atmosphere of this picturesque town.

Finally, travel onward to the Riviera Maya, where you will be dropped off in Cancún, Playa del Carmen, or Tulum town. (Drop-off in Tulum hotel zone and Bahía Petempich is not included.)

Once you arrive, the rest of your Caribbean stay is yours to enjoy—relax on the beach or inquire about optional extensions to continue your adventure.

Included:
• Transportation
• Guided tour at Chichén Itzá
• Entrance fees
• Lunch
• Cenote visit
• Drop-off in Riviera Maya

Not Included:
• Tips
• Personal expenses
• Overnight stay in Riviera Maya (optional)
